description: Port the gesture state machine and its host tests from empire-remastered rml_mod/src/gesture_*.h onto J28's route: Alt+drag moves the selection to the drawn line (frontage from the drag length), Alt+Ctrl+drag rotates it in place; vanilla drags untouched; a drag preview (route chosen in the brief). Bindings in the hotkeys registry with the clash gate green (Alt+F4 hazard). Host tests green, a harness walk in the 40-unit battle, and Liam signs off the feel in a real battle (phase 4 gate).
title: Alt-drag move and Alt+Ctrl-drag rotate
